newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 a tonne higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 a tonne higher.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open $5 firmer Friday as traders expect the market to follow through on recent gains.
New York cocoa futures posted gains for the third straight session Thursday, but benchmark September once again failed to fill a key chart gap up to $1,610 per tonne.
CSCE September ended up $5 at $1,599 after ranging from $1,609 to $1,575. Spot July gained $8 to $1,580, with the rest $4 to $5 firmer.
On the charts, traders said $1,610 was still an upside target for September, with the next level of resistance at $1,625. Strong support was noted near $1,575.
London cocoa futures were tightly mixed in rangebound dealings early Friday, with LIFFE September down two stg at the midday break, to 1,053 stg, after trading from 1,063 to 1,053 stg.
